triple_constraint.standard_of_care: Immigration status is the ultimate vulnerability. When the legal system — dissolution courts, criminal proceedings, or identity fraud schemes — weaponizes immigration status against someone who cannot understand the proceedings, every protection fails simultaneously. The interpreter is not a convenience; it is due process itself. The TRUST Act is not a sanctuary law; it is a prohibition on using California resources to enforce a federal civil regulatory scheme against California residents.
